name: Commonwealth Fusion Systems
thesis: Compact tokamaks built around high-temperature superconducting magnets. Building the SPARC demonstration machine, with a first power plant planned in Virginia.

name: Helion
thesis: Pulsed fusion that recovers electricity directly from the plasma, with no steam turbine. Has a contract to deliver power to Microsoft.

name: Fervo Energy
thesis: Applies horizontal drilling and fracturing from shale to hot rock, making geothermal possible far from natural hot springs. Building Cape Station in Utah.

name: X-energy
thesis: High-temperature gas reactors fueled by TRISO pebbles, aimed at industrial heat as well as power. Backed by Dow and Amazon.

name: Form Energy
thesis: Iron-air batteries that discharge for about 100 hours, built to carry a grid through multi-day gaps in wind and sun.

name: Quaise Energy
thesis: Millimeter-wave drilling that vaporizes rock to reach superhot temperatures much deeper than conventional bits can go.

name: TerraPower
thesis: Natrium: a sodium-cooled fast reactor paired with molten-salt heat storage so output can follow demand. First plant in Kemmerer, Wyoming.

name: Base Power
thesis: Installs home batteries and sells the electricity itself, turning thousands of houses into one distributed power plant.

name: TAE Technologies
thesis: Beam-driven field-reversed plasmas, with the long-term goal of burning hydrogen-boron fuel that produces almost no neutrons.

name: Pacific Fusion
thesis: Pulsed magnetic inertial fusion: huge electrical pulses crush small fuel targets, with no lasers involved.

name: Zap Energy
thesis: A sheared-flow Z-pinch that confines plasma with its own current, removing the need for large magnets.

name: Type One Energy
thesis: Stellarators designed with modern computing and built with superconducting magnets, developed alongside the Tennessee Valley Authority.

name: General Fusion
thesis: Magnetized target fusion: a liquid-metal wall is driven inward by pistons to compress the plasma.

name: Tokamak Energy
thesis: Spherical tokamaks combined with high-temperature superconducting magnets, which it also sells as a product.

name: Proxima Fusion
thesis: A stellarator company spun out of the Max Planck Institute for Plasma Physics, building on the Wendelstein 7-X experiment.

name: Kyoto Fusioneering
thesis: Builds the plant around the plasma: heating systems, breeding blankets and fuel-cycle equipment that every fusion developer will need.

name: Energy Singularity
thesis: Built HH70, a tokamak whose magnets are all high-temperature superconductors, and is working toward a larger successor.

name: Oklo
thesis: Small sodium-cooled fast reactors that it plans to own and operate, selling power directly rather than selling reactors.

name: Kairos Power
thesis: Fluoride-salt-cooled reactors using pebble fuel. Building the Hermes demonstration reactor in Oak Ridge and has a supply deal with Google.

name: Radiant
thesis: Kaleidos, a one-megawatt reactor that fits in a shipping container, intended to replace diesel generators at remote sites.

name: Valar Atomics
thesis: Small high-temperature gas reactors designed to be mass-produced and clustered at large sites.

name: Aalo Atomics
thesis: Factory-built sodium-cooled reactors packaged into modular plants sized for data centers.

name: Last Energy
thesis: A 20-megawatt pressurized water reactor built from standard modules and sold to industrial customers under power contracts.

name: newcleo
thesis: Lead-cooled fast reactors designed to run on fuel recycled from existing nuclear waste.

name: Zeno Power
thesis: Radioisotope power systems that turn decay heat from strontium-90 into electricity for the seabed, the Moon and other places with no grid.

name: Sage Geosystems
thesis: Uses pressurized underground fractures both to generate geothermal power and to store energy like a buried battery.

name: Eavor
thesis: Closed-loop geothermal: sealed wells circulate fluid through deep rock like a radiator. First commercial project is in Geretsried, Germany.

name: Bedrock Energy
thesis: Autonomous drill rigs that install ground-source heating and cooling under commercial buildings.

name: Antora Energy
thesis: Heats carbon blocks with cheap renewable electricity, then delivers that energy to factories as heat or power on demand.

name: Rondo Energy
thesis: Heat batteries made of brick that store electricity as high-temperature heat for industrial steam.

name: Redwood Materials
thesis: Recycles batteries into new cathode and anode materials, and reuses retired EV packs as grid storage.

name: Group14 Technologies
thesis: Silicon-carbon anode material that lets lithium-ion cells hold more energy and charge faster.

name: Koloma
thesis: Explores for hydrogen that forms naturally underground, treating it as a resource to drill for rather than manufacture.

name: Electric Hydrogen
thesis: Complete 100-megawatt electrolyzer plants designed to bring down the installed cost of green hydrogen.

name: Twelve
thesis: Electrolyzes captured carbon dioxide and water into the building blocks of jet fuel and chemicals.

name: Stegra
thesis: Building a steel plant in Boden, Sweden that uses green hydrogen in place of coal. Formerly H2 Green Steel.

name: Sublime Systems
thesis: Makes cement electrochemically at ambient temperature, with no kiln and no limestone emissions.

name: Boston Metal
thesis: Molten oxide electrolysis: uses electricity directly to split iron ore into liquid metal and oxygen.

name: Heirloom
thesis: Direct air capture that speeds up the way limestone naturally absorbs carbon dioxide.

name: Reflect Orbital
thesis: Plans satellites carrying large mirrors that redirect sunlight onto solar farms after dark.

name: Exowatt
thesis: Modular units that collect solar heat, store it, and dispatch electricity around the clock for data centers.

name: SunDrive
thesis: Solar cells that use copper instead of silver for their contacts, removing one of the industry's supply limits.
